judgment.rationale: This manuscript proposes a novel neuro-symbolic framework to eliminate hallucinations in large language models. It integrates symbolic knowledge constraints into neural generative processes, enabling real-time self-verification and logical coherence. The framework shows great promise in achieving zero false factual generation in open-ended reasoning tasks, with broad applicability across domains.
